effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Main Phase] [On Play] By placing 1 [Xros Heart] or [Twilight] trait Digimon card from your hand or trash under this Tamer, if you have 7 or fewer cards in your hand, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
[Main] By suspending this Tamer, you may play 1 level 5 or higher [Xros Heart] trait Digimon card from under any of your Tamers with the play cost reduced by 1.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
